svg.aria-label: Console clock error over five days
svg.title: Console clock error over five days
svg.desc: The clock error falls steadily through each day and jumps up just after midnight, a sawtooth. Each day the whole sawtooth sits a little higher, until it leaves the band the driver allows and is stepped back two seconds.
svg.text: Console clock error, seconds (positive is fast)
shaded: the allowed band, which is the centered sawtooth give or take clock_recenter_threshold
